errors.error_description: Used the case-equality operator (===) in synthesizable RTL to compare opcode, which is a misuse of operators and can lead to non-synthesizable or unintended behavior.
Mixed blocking (=) assignment with non-blocking (<=) assignments within the same sequential always_ff block, creating a potential race condition.
Declared an internal signal (debug_unused) that is never driven or used, resulting in an unused signal.
